exposure: Intraluminal pressure (ILP) of Bakri intrauterine balloon
outcome: Intraluminal pressure (ILP) required to achieve a positive tamponade test
cohort: The study included 20 patients with severe postpartum hemorrhage (blood loss >1 L) receiving Bakri intrauterine balloon tamponade.
finding: A positive tamponade test with an intrauterine balloon is likely achieved by local compression on the vasculature of the placental bed, rather than by generating ILP exceeding systemic blood pressure or by occluding uterine arteries.
